papers.title_en: LOCI: Localized Continuous Control for Multi-Subject Image Editing
papers.authors: Sai Vidyaranya Nuthalapati, Shlok Kumar Mishra
papers.evidence: 多主体图像编辑中的局部连续控制
papers.tldr: 指令式图像编辑虽灵活，却难以精确控制编辑位置与强度；现有方法要么全局连续调强，要么局部固定强度，无法同时支持多主体独立控制。LOCI 为每个主体绑定注意力实现空间隔离，并用 Regional LoRA 的逐 token 缩放向量替代标量系数，在单一抑制点训练后于推理阶段重缩放区域残差，实现逐区域连续强度。多主体实验中，它保持高编辑保真度并显著降低跨区域干扰。该工作将空间定位、连续强度和多主体独立编辑统一起来。
papers.abstract_en: Recent instruction-following image editors such as Flux.1-Kontext enable text-driven editing but lack fine-grained control over where and how much an edit is applied. Existing approaches provide either continuous but global control or spatially localized editing at a fixed strength. To our knowledge, none jointly supports explicit spatial localization, continuous per-region strength, and independent simultaneous control of multiple subjects. We present LOCI (LOcalized Continuous control for multi- subject Image editing). Given a multi-subject image with per-subject regions and instructions, LOCI edits each subject at an independently chosen, continuously adjustable strength, for instance gradually aging one person while adding a beard to another with minimal cross-region leakage. LOCI pairs subject-level attention binding for spatial isolation with a Regional LoRA layer that replaces the LoRA's scalar coefficient with a per-token scaling vector aligned to the spatial layout. A single adapter is trained at one suppression point, and continuous edit strengths follow by rescaling its regional residual at inference. Experiments on multi-subject scenes demonstrate that LOCI achieves strong edit fidelity with significantly reduced cross-region interference compared to baselines, while maintaining continuous control over edit strength

papers.title_en: CrossPair: Unlocking Generalist Visual Transformation Learning in Image Editors
papers.authors: Yibo Zhao, Lifan Jiang, Senlin cheng, Tianrun Wu, Bolei Xu, Xiaobo Li, Can Ye, Xiaofei He, Dehai Zhao, Boxi Wu
papers.evidence: 图像编辑器中的通用视觉变换学习
papers.tldr: 视觉任务长期依赖修复、编辑、风格化等分立系统，难以像语言模型那样从示例中切换任务。CrossPair将预训练多模态图像编辑器用于单对前后示例的通用变换迁移：VLM提取操作语义，VAE保留外观与结构，并用仅训练阶段的DINOv3变化感知目标对齐跨内容场景的特征变化方向。在Relation252K派生已见与留出变换上，它提升了目标一致性和编辑方向相似度；配合Transform-360K训练还改善留出操作聚合得分，展示了示例驱动通用视觉变换的可行路径。
papers.abstract_en: Language models switch tasks from demonstrations, but vision still often relies on separate systems for restoration, editing, and stylization. A before--after example offers a shared instruction only if the transferable change can be separated from the scene that demonstrates it. We introduce CrossPair, which adapts a pretrained multimodal image editor to transfer diverse transformations from one exemplar pair. Exemplar-before, exemplar-after, and query images take fixed roles in its native VLM and VAE pathways: the VLM extracts operation semantics, while the VAE retains fine appearance and structure. A training-only, change-aware DINOv3 objective aligns feature-change directions across content-distinct scenes, guiding the output to follow the demonstrated relation without an inference-time encoder. We construct Transform-360K by grouping filtered pairs from conditional representations, restoration, editing, virtual try-on, and stylization under shared transformations. On Relation252K-derived seen and held-out transformations, \method improves target agreement and edit-direction similarity over released systems. Ablations show that the semantic and visual exemplar routes are complementary and that DINO relation alignment further strengthens transfer; Transform-360K training also improves aggregate held-out-operation scores.

papers.title_en: EditJev: System One Routing for Image Editing Models
papers.authors: Zhile Guan, Xu Jiang, Yule Duan, Gongbo Zhang, Shuyu Wang, Xiao Chen, Jian Zhang
papers.tldr: 同一图像与编辑指令下，不同图像编辑模型效果差异明显，最佳模型随请求变化，而各模型推理延迟也不同，固定单一模型部署效率低。为此提出 EditJev，一种 System One 路由模型，用视觉语言骨干上的轻量偏好头单次前向预测样本级偏好分数，无需自回归生成模型名或解析输出。在 ImgEdit 与 GEdit-En 上，聚合质量分别从 4.540 提升到 4.592、从 8.194 提升到 8.255，端到端延迟估计降低 60.8% 与 31.7%。该工作验证了直接、结构化的模型路由可兼顾编辑质量与效率。
papers.abstract_en: Instruction-based image editing models exhibit pronounced sample-specific performance variation: different models can produce substantially different results for the same source image and editing instruction, and the best-performing model often varies across requests. These models also differ substantially in inference latency, making fixed-model deployment inefficient. We therefore study image editing model routing, which dynamically selects an editor from a candidate pool given an input image and editing instruction. We introduce EditJev, a System One routing model that directly predicts sample-level preference scores over candidate image editing models in a single forward pass. A lightweight preference head on a vision-language backbone produces a fixed-dimensional score vector without autoregressive model-name generation or response parsing. To train EditJev, we construct pairwise preferences from offline candidate outputs and optimize a pairwise ranking objective to learn relative model suitability. At inference time, EditJev combines the predicted preference scores with model-level speed scores to balance editing quality and generation latency. Experiments on ImgEdit and GEdit-En show that EditJev improves aggregate quality over the strongest fixed editor, from 4.540 to 4.592 and from 8.194 to 8.255, respectively, while reducing estimated end-to-end latency by 60.8% and 31.7%. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of direct, structured model routing for efficient image editing.

papers.title_en: KINESYS: Test-Time Adaptation for Reference-Based Effect Editing in Images
papers.authors: Noah Frahm, Luchao Qi, Haoze Li, Dan B Goldman, Sambit Bhattacharya, Roni Sengupta
papers.evidence: 面向参考效果图像编辑的测试时自适应
papers.tldr: 视觉特效往往难以用文字精确描述，用参考图演示更自然；但现有单次编辑方法难以完成细粒度编辑，容易误改源内容或偏离参考效果。KINESYS 提出一种测试时自适应框架，融合参考感知与源感知反馈，并通过跨多个噪声样本和多次优化运行的稳健优化策略微调生成模型。在 VLM 评判、LPIPS/TPIPS 源保持指标与用户研究中，其源内容保持优于现有图像编辑器，效果迁移与 Nano Banana 2 相当并超过开源编辑器。
papers.abstract_en: Visual effects are often easier to demonstrate via reference than to describe in words. We study effect-reference editing, where a reference image shows a desired visual effect and language identifies which properties should guide the edit. Existing single-pass editing techniques often fail to make fine-grained edits, resulting in unintended changes to source content or deviations from the reference effect. We introduce KINESYS, a test-time adaptation framework for effect-reference editing that combines reference-aware and source-aware feedback to transfer the desired effect while preserving the composition and content of the original shot. To ensure KINESYS can produce a diverse set of edits that preserve the source, we develop a robust optimization strategy in which the generative model is fine-tuned across multiple noise samples and optimization runs. Evaluation with VLM judges, source preservation metrics (LPIPS, TPIPS), and a user study shows that KINESYS outperforms state-of-the-art image editors in source preservation; on effect transfer, it remains competitive with Nano Banana 2 and outperforms open-weight editors.

papers.authors: Phuc Lai, Anh Nguyen, Phong Nguyen, Anh Tran
papers.evidence: 用于百万像素扩散合成的级联细化上采样
papers.tldr: 百万像素级视觉合成需在超出训练分辨率下运行，级联细化会反复进行像素空间缩放并多次经过VAE，成为被忽视的瓶颈。UltraFlash 提出面向像素空间转换的加速方案：用 Latent Hyperloop 以学习到的潜空间捷径替代中间 RGB 解码-缩放-编码往返，并用 Sparse Patch-based Decoding 复用 GroupNorm 统计、减少 patch 重叠以加速最终解码。在先进级联基线中，它将 4K 生成延迟约降低 2 倍，同时提升图像质量。结果表明优化 VAE 相关像素空间转换可同时改善效率与保真度，为快速高质量百万像素合成提供有效路径。
papers.abstract_en: Megapixel visual synthesis with latent diffusion models requires operating far beyond the resolutions at which these models are typically trained. Cascade refinement is a leading strategy for this setting: it starts from a base image at a native resolution and progressively upsamples it to the target resolution through multiple refinement stages. Each stage typically performs a pixel-space resolution transition followed by latent-space denoising. While prior acceleration efforts mainly focus on reducing denoising cost, we identify a complementary and underexplored bottleneck: the repeated movement of representations through the VAE. We call these operations pixel-space transitions. In cascade pipelines, intermediate latents are often decoded to RGB, resized, and re-encoded before refinement, while final latents are decoded patch by patch with dense overlap to suppress boundary artifacts. We propose UltraFlash, a transition-efficient approach that accelerates these VAE-heavy operations. UltraFlash has two components. Latent Hyperloop replaces intermediate RGB round trips with a learned latent-space shortcut that approximates the decode-resize-encode transformation without repeated VAE decoding and encoding. Sparse Patch-based Decoding accelerates final reconstruction by addressing patch seams caused by inconsistent GroupNorm statistics and reusing cached statistics across patches, enabling sparse VAE decoding with much smaller overlap. Integrated into a state-of-the-art cascade baseline, UltraFlash reduces 4K generation latency by approximately 2x while improving image quality. These results show that optimizing pixel-space transitions can improve both efficiency and fidelity, offering an effective route toward fast, high-quality megapixel visual synthesis.

papers.title_en: Grounded Exploration for Open-Ended Image Editing
papers.authors: Jieyu Zhou, Mehdi Ben Ayed, Shubham Gupta, Zhenyu Tan, Jiajing Xu, Dmitry Kislyuk, Eric Tzeng, Christopher J. MacLellan, Charles Rosenberg
papers.evidence: 面向开放式图像编辑的两阶段接地框架
papers.tldr: 开放图像编辑请求常存在多种合理解法，直接采样易产生无依据变化，而显式多样性提示又常只带来表面差异。为此，论文提出两阶段框架：先识别多样且可行的编辑范围，再将其转化为可执行编辑指令。在300个开放编辑任务上，该方法较直接多样性提示提升24.6%平均语义分散度和17.1%平均 groundedness，并生成更多有效且不同的实现。其贡献在于先结构化可行编辑方向、后具体实现，从而在保留合理歧义的同时实现更有依据的开放探索。
papers.abstract_en: Open-ended image-editing requests, such as ``decorate this room,'' admit multiple valid realizations. Direct sampling may produce ungrounded variation, whereas explicit diversity prompting often produces superficial differences. We study how to ground these requests without prematurely eliminating their legitimate ambiguity. We introduce a two-stage framework that first identifies diverse, feasible edit scopes and then realizes them as executable edit instructions. Across 300 open-ended image-editing tasks, our approach achieves 24.6% higher mean semantic dispersion and 17.1% higher mean groundedness than direct diversity prompting, while producing more valid and distinct realizations. These results show that structuring feasible edit directions before realization supports more useful grounded exploration.

papers.title_en: The Noise-Transmission Burden of Diffusion Network: Why Image Prediction Can Outperform Noise Prediction
papers.authors: Gyeonghun Kang, Pengxi Liu, Bingshuo Qian, Xiang Cheng
papers.evidence: 扩散网络中噪声预测与图像预测的对比分析
papers.tldr: 扩散模型中干净图像预测与噪声预测在总体最优意义下等价，但有限网络下表现差异显著。论文提出噪声传输负担：噪声预测器须保留抵消输入损坏的信息，线性输入瓶颈即使下游计算不受限也会带来去噪误差下限。理论表明图像预测风险仍有界，EDM可高噪声衰减、精确预条件可各噪声级消除该瓶颈，ImageNet/JiT实验验证。该工作从去噪角度解释预测目标、预条件和模型宽度导致的生成质量差距。
papers.abstract_en: Clean-image prediction ($x$-prediction) and noise prediction yield equivalent population-optimal denoisers, yet can perform very differently in finite diffusion networks. For noisy input $Y_t$ with noise standard deviation $σ_t$, a noise predictor $f_{\varepsilon,t}$ induces the clean-image estimate $\widehat X_1=Y_t-σ_t f_{\varepsilon,t}(Y_t)$. This reveals a noise-transmission burden: the predictor must preserve information needed to cancel the input corruption. Under Gaussian corruption of $d$-dimensional data, a linear input bottleneck of rank $r<d$ imposes a denoising-error floor $σ_t^2(d-r)$ even with unrestricted downstream computation, while the corresponding optimal risk for image prediction remains bounded. EDM attenuates this bottleneck contribution at high noise; exact preconditioning cancels it at every noise level. Without an input bottleneck, assuming exact affine recovery of the noisy patch from the model representation, we characterize how the covariance spectrum of corrections beyond linear denoising determines the width required above the patch dimension. ImageNet experiments with JiT show that measured denoising losses reflect the predicted bottleneck floor and its attenuation or cancellation through preconditioning. Further widening yields larger relative denoising gains at low noise, where corrections beyond linear denoising spread across more directions, consistent with our spectral characterization of the required model width. Together, these results provide a denoising-based account of practical generation-quality gaps across prediction targets, preconditioning choices, and model widths.

papers.title_en: SpeeDiff: Scalable Pixel-Anchored End-to-End Latent Diffusion Model
papers.authors: Bingliang Zhang, Wenda Chu, Yizhuo Li, Linjie Yang, Yisong Yue, Katherine L. Bouman, Yang Song, Qiushan Guo
papers.evidence: 采用像素锚定Tweedie重建损失的端到端潜在扩散模型
papers.tldr: 潜扩散常采用两阶段训练，冻结VAE限制生成友好潜空间形成；端到端联合训练又易因扩散梯度反传导致潜空间坍缩。SpeeDiff提出Tweedie像素重建损失，从中间噪声态解码预测干净潜变量并施加像素级反馈，稳定VAE与扩散模型联合训练。其全Transformer架构可联合扩展，SpeeDiff-XL在ImageNet 256上无引导FID达1.50，训练较SiT/REPA快140倍/61倍。该工作表明像素锚定端到端训练可兼顾速度、可扩展性与生成质量。
papers.abstract_en: We present Scalable Pixel-anchored End-to-end Diffusion (SpeeDiff), a latent diffusion method that jointly trains the VAE and the diffusion model from scratch. In principle, joint training allows the diffusion loss gradient to directly guide the VAE encoder, encouraging the formation of a generation-friendly latent space and potentially yielding faster convergence than the conventional two-stage approach with a pretrained frozen VAE. However, a naive end-to-end implementation severely degrades performance, as unrestricted backpropagation of the diffusion loss leads to latent space collapse. Our main technical contribution is a simple yet effective Tweedie Pixel Reconstruction (TPR) loss, which provides additional pixel-level feedback by decoding a predicted clean latent from an intermediate noisy state using Tweedie's formula, thereby alleviating collapse. Furthermore, our method enables jointly scaling a fully transformer-based architecture and enhances representation alignment within the end-to-end framework. Our SpeeDiff-XL model achieves over 140x and 61x faster training compared to Vanilla SiT and REPA, respectively, while attaining an FID of 1.50 without guidance on ImageNet 256x256 generation. With a more efficient 32x compressed VAE, our model further reaches an FID of 1.53 without guidance on ImageNet 512x512 generation.

papers.title_en: Physics Guided Diffusion Model Based Exposure Interpolation for High Dynamic Range Imaging
papers.evidence: 物理引导扩散模型用于HDR曝光插值与伪影去除
papers.tldr: 多帧HDR成像中鬼影问题突出，单次拍摄两幅大曝光比SDR图像又会引入亮度顺序反转伪影，需插值中间曝光图像。本文提出物理引导扩散模型曝光插值算法：物理驱动组件生成初始图，扩散模型组件重建残差高频细节，并设计新预测目标以降低噪声数据与目标间Pearson相关性波动及拟合误差放大。实验验证该方法较现有CNN神经增强插值更易生成高频信息，为无鬼影HDR成像提供有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Ghosting artifacts are an open problem for popular multi-shot based high dynamic range (HDR) imaging. An effective solution is to capture two large-exposure-ratio (LER) standard dynamic range (SDR) images simultaneously via a single-shot. Brightness order reversal (BOR) artifacts are generated when the two LER images are directly fused together. It is crucial to interpolate an image with an exposure time in between the exposure times of two LER images. In this paper, a novel physics-guided diffusion model based exposure interpolation algorithm is proposed to address the BOR artifacts. An initial image is interpolated by a physics-driven component, and the residual high-frequency details are generated by a new diffusion model based component. The new diffusion model is based on the correlation analysis of generative models and includes a new predicted target to reduce the variation of the Pearson correlation between the noisy data and the target, as well as the amplification factor of the fitting error. Compared with existing neural augmented exposure interpolation algorithms on top of convolution neural networks, the proposed exposure interpolation algorithm has an inherent advantage to generate more high frequency information. Experiment results validate the proposed exposure interpolation algorithm.

papers.title_en: MoI-Bench: A Benchmark for Image Generation and Editing on Mobile Devices
papers.authors: Kailai Feng, Haoxiang Rao, Yuxiang Wei, Bo Chen, Junsong Li, Yang Pan, Chengkun Cai, Jagmohan Chauhan
papers.evidence: 图像生成与编辑模型评测基准
papers.tldr: 现有基准难以为移动端图像生成与编辑模型提供细粒度能力差距诊断。作者提出MoI-Bench，含64个子任务、1150个样本，以16种操作和8类视觉目标构成正交任务轴，并提出MoI-Eval进行任务特定评估。实验显示操作×目标解耦能定位如文本替换等具体短板，并构建质量-可部署性二维能力图。该基准强调当前端侧模型应优先扩展任务覆盖与提升编辑质量。
papers.abstract_en: Developing on-device image models requires considering practical user needs, task types and device resource constraints. However, existing benchmarks provide limited guidance on identifying capability gaps between on-device models and server-side models. We introduce MoI-Bench, a benchmark grounded in mobile user needs, comprising 64 subtasks and 1150 samples. It defines 16 operations, such as removal and replacement, and eight visual target categories covering content such as portraits and text. These form two orthogonal axes whose applicable combinations define specific tasks, such as removing facial makeup. To better guide model improvement, we further propose MoI-Eval, which introduces task-specific criteria covering instruction following, visual quality and detail preservation. We further construct sample-level evaluation questions and aggregate their scores into overall quality and capability profiles along the operation, target and criteria axes. We evaluate representative on-device and server-side models and measure mobile deployment costs. Results show that this decoupled Operation x Target design provides finer-grained guidance for improving compact models. For example, it highlights the need to prioritize specific capability gaps (e.g., text-replacement) over broad application-level goals (e.g., improving text editing). Unlike conventional benchmarks that rank models using a single score, we introduce a two-dimensional Quality-Deployability capability map to assess models for practical mobile use. The map shows that current on-device models can achieve efficient generation or editing but expanding their task coverage deserves greater attention than further improving deployment efficiency. Further progress requires improving editing quality, particularly identity preservation and text rendering, while broadening task coverage.

papers.title_en: Seeing through Denoising: Frequency-guided One-step Denoising for Infrared Small Target Detection
papers.authors: Xuelin Qian, Zixuan Wang, Chang Xu, Dingwen Zhang, Junwei Han
papers.evidence: 基于扩散模型背景重建的红外小目标检测
papers.tldr: 红外小目标检测受目标极小、信噪比低和背景杂波强困扰，现有判别式方法直接映射掩码且忽视生成建模。DiffIRSTD将检测重构为背景重建，把目标视作类噪声信号，用扩散模型从扰动图像恢复无目标背景，并以残差突出候选目标；一步去噪降低采样开销，频域感知损失保留高频背景细节。在IRSTD-1K、NUAA-SIRST和NUDT-SIRST上取得领先性能，并可作为即插即用框架兼容现有检测器，为红外小目标检测提供生成式新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Infrared small target detection (IRSTD) is a challenging task due to the extremely small size of targets, low signal-to-noise ratios, and heavy background clutter in infrared imagery. While the progress of deep learning has advanced this field, existing methods primarily adopt discriminative paradigms that directly map images to target masks, overlooking the potential of generative modeling. In this paper, we propose DiffIRSTD, a novel generative framework that reformulates infrared small target detection as a background reconstruction problem. Instead of explicitly predicting target regions, we reinterpret small targets as noise-like signals and leverage a diffusion-based model to recover a clean, target-free background from a perturbed input image. The residual between the reconstructed background and the original image is then exploited to highlight candidate target regions, providing explicit cues for subsequent detection. To address the computational cost typically associated with diffusion sampling, we introduce a one-step denoising strategy that enables efficient background reconstruction while maintaining practical inference speed. Furthermore, we present a frequency-guided perception loss to preserve high-frequency background details and focus more on the reconstruction quality of target regions. More importantly, our DiffIRSTD operates as a plug-and-play framework, compatible with existing IRSTD models without increasing the computational complexity of detectors. Extensive experiments on IRSTD-1K, NUAA-SIRST, and NUDT-SIRST datasets demonstrate the superiority of our method, achieving state-of-the-art performance across three benchmarks.

papers.title_en: Generative Modeling via Nonlinear Schrödinger Bridges and Branching Diffusions
papers.evidence: 非线性薛定谔桥生成建模框架
papers.tldr: 该文从平均场博弈与非线性薛定谔系统出发，将前向-后向PDE重新解释为生成建模框架。作者提出SBNL，以耦合PDE刻画经典薛定谔桥的非线性扩展，并用分支扩散与半线性PDE概率表示设计仿真算法。方法可并行、可扩展至高维，支持多种非线性交互泛函，并在MNIST、FFHQ及经典桥恢复等实验中验证。该框架统一嵌入score-based生成、扩散模型与可处理高斯薛定谔桥，拓展了生成建模的理论与数值路径。
papers.abstract_en: We propose a new generative modeling framework grounded in forward-backward partial differential equations (PDEs). These equations arise naturally in mean-field game (MFG) theory, and are closely related to nonlinear Schrödinger systems. Our main contribution is to reinterpret this connection within the setting of generative modeling and to develop an efficient numerical methodology for its practical implementation. Specifically, we derive and characterize a nonlinear extension of the classical Schrödinger bridge problem through a coupled system of PDEs, yielding a model we call SBNL (Schrödinger Bridge NonLinear). To compute its solution, we design a simulation algorithm based on branching diffusions and the probabilistic representation of semilinear PDEs. The resulting method is embarrassingly parallel, scalable to high dimensions, and applicable to a broad class of nonlinear interaction functionals. We validate the approach through numerical experiments, including recovery of the classical Schrödinger bridge, nonlinear extensions with convex penalties (Gross-Pitaevskii) as well as potential interaction terms, and high-dimensional generative tasks such as image synthesis on the MNIST and FFHQ human face dataset. Furthermore, the same framework embeds score-based generative modeling, diffusion models, and tractable gaussian Schrödinger bridges.

papers.title_en: How Do DiTs Denoise? An Aggregator-Predictor View of Attention and MLPs
papers.authors: Gyeonghun Kang, William Xingxu Chen, Xiang Cheng
papers.evidence: 扩散Transformer去噪的聚合器-预测器解释
papers.tldr: 针对DiT如何表征图像并复用规则去噪的问题，作者提出“聚合器—预测器”视角，将注意力解释为输入与噪声自适应的上下文聚合器，将MLP解释为逐token的patch预测器。基于GMRF先验，他们证明全局贝叶斯去噪可由局部上下文近似且误差随半径指数衰减，并用实验验证真实图像DiT呈现噪声依赖的上下文与注意力展宽。CelebA64中用共享记忆patch预测器替换MLP仍具竞争力，跨数据集组件移植也符合QK、VO与MLP的功能分工。
papers.abstract_en: How do diffusion transformers (DiTs) represent image content and learn rules for reusing it to generalize? We develop an aggregator--predictor view of DiTs as input-adaptive local denoisers, in which context aggregation and patch prediction provide functional roles for interpreting attention and MLPs. We first establish that, for Gaussian Markov random field (GMRF) priors, the global Bayes denoiser can be approximated using only a subset of context patches, with error decaying exponentially in context radius. We further show that patchwise linear denoisers, often invoked to explain diffusion generalization, recover the empirical local denoiser with sufficiently informative aggregation. Within this view, AdaLN-modulated attention naturally parameterizes an input- and noise-dependent aggregator, while the MLP admits a learned key--value representation for tokenwise patch prediction. Our experiments support this view. DiTs trained on real images exhibit noise-dependent denoising contexts resembling those in the analytic GMRF setting, while attention mass exhibits a qualitatively corresponding broadening pattern. In a controlled CelebA64 study, shared-memory patch predictors used in place of DiT MLPs achieve competitive denoising and generative performance. Finally, cross-dataset component transplantation reveals compatibility patterns consistent with the proposed roles of QK in spatial weighting, VO in feature transport, and MLPs in patch prediction. Together, these results provide a component-level account of DiT denoising and motivate architecture-specific fine-tuning and controlled intervention.

papers.title_en: RealMe: Immersive Volumetric Video from Minimal Captures
papers.authors: Chenxu Zhou, Zhiyuan Yu, Yudong Jin, Yinji Shentu, Yu Zhang, Jiaming Sun, Xiaowei Zhou
papers.evidence: 高分辨率视频扩散模型将稀疏捕获增强为4D一致的体积视频
papers.tldr: 稀疏低分辨率采集难以重建沉浸式体积视频，密集多视图成本高。RealMe以高分辨率视频扩散模型为核心，将有限多视图视频增强为2K、4D一致视频以细化4D表示。它构建辅助数据与布局感知位置嵌入，采用适配多视图布局的分解时空注意力跨视点与时间去噪，并用潜空间频域损失缩小生成与真实采集差距。在DNA-Rendering和自建RealVV上，RealMe在视觉保真与4D一致性上优于现有方法，降低采集门槛。
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses the problem of creating immersive volumetric videos from sparse and low-resolution capture resources. Conventional dense multi-view reconstruction methods can produce high-quality volumetric videos, but their reliance on costly capture setups makes them impractical in real-world scenarios. Recent approaches use generative models to relax capture requirements, but still suffer from limited resolution and 4D inconsistency. To overcome these constraints, we propose RealMe, a unified framework built around a high-resolution video diffusion model that enhances limited captures into high-resolution (2K), 4D-consistent videos for volumetric video reconstruction. Specifically, RealMe constructs auxiliary data from capture videos and encodes them into latents along with layout-aware positional embeddings. The video diffusion model adapts factorized spatio-temporal attention to the multi-view capture layout, denoises these latents across viewpoints and time, and decodes them into enhanced videos to refine the 4D representation. This adaptation helps the model capture temporal dynamics and multi-view relationships, leading to more 4D-consistent generation. To reduce the data gap between generated videos and real captures, we apply a latent frequency loss that provides frequency-domain supervision in latent space. Extensive experiments on the public DNA-Rendering benchmark and our self-captured RealVV dataset demonstrate that RealMe is able to create immersive volumetric videos and outperforms state-of-the-art methods in visual fidelity and 4D consistency.

papers.title_en: Large-size multivariate scale-free texture generation from small-size learning sets with self-attention Wasserstein-GAN
papers.authors: Jhonatan Ancco Cerda, Kinan Abbas, Stéphane G. Roux, Patrice Abry
papers.evidence: 使用Wasserstein-GAN生成大尺寸多变量无标度纹理
papers.tldr: 多变量无标度纹理生成常需从较小样本合成任意尺寸图像，但参数模型受限，现有神经网络方法也缺少对多尺度统计的定量评估。该文将卷积Wasserstein-GAN与自注意力层结合，不把模型写入损失函数，而直接学习并复现多尺度统计。在代表性多重分形纹理上经十次独立训练，可生成尺寸达原图8×8倍且统计准确的纹理。研究表明自注意力置于critic时跨输出尺寸表现最稳定，为小样本大尺寸纹理生成提供了可量化方案。
papers.abstract_en: Multivariate scale-free texture images are nowadays central in numerous modern applications very different in nature. A common challenging issue consists of being able to generate such multivariate textures at any arbitrary size, from a learning set of (possibly much) smaller size. Parametric models often turn out to be too restrictive for the generation of realistic textures, thus prompting neural network training-based generation. While several neural network approaches propose generation at sizes larger than training, they do not explicitly assess the quality of the generation by quantifying how well multiscale or scale-free statistics in textures are reproduced and rather rely on perceptual assessment. The present work combines convolutional Wasserstein-GAN architectures with self-attention layers to generate textures of arbitrary size while focusing on reproducing multiscale statistics, without coding a model into the loss function. The relevance of using a self-attention layer is studied. Quantitative assessment conducted on multifractal textures, representative of a broad class of multiscale textures, over ten independent trainings shows that the proposed architecture is able to generate textures with accurate statistics for sizes $8 \times 8$ larger than the originals. The results show that placing self-attention in the critic provides the most consistent performance across output sizes.

papers.title_en: Unlocking Spatial Grounding in Flow-Matching Models via SNR Tuning
papers.evidence: 通过信噪比调优提升流匹配生成模型的空间定位
papers.tldr: 扩散/流匹配生成模型虽能生成高质量图像，但细粒度空间布局控制仍弱，常需结构适配器或推理时引导。本文用几何图元合成基准与颜色感知布局指标，隔离纹理干扰，发现信噪比（SNR）分布决定空间定位：居中 SNR 训练布局遵循率仅25.9%。将训练重心移向高噪声“关键学习阶段”后，遵循率升至80.8%，接近VAE重建上限83.6%。在COCO上仅调分布即把平均精度从1.0提至57.3，无需改架构，表明SNR调优可释放流匹配模型的空间定位能力。
papers.abstract_en: Despite the success of foundation models in image synthesis, achieving fine-grained spatial control remains a significant challenge, typically requiring auxiliary structural adapters or complex inference-time steering. While modern vision-language (VLM) text encoders possess the latent capacity to represent spatial coordinates, generative models often fail to leverage this information. We demonstrate that the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) distribution is a critical determinant of spatial grounding in flow-matching models. Using a novel synthetic benchmark of geometric primitives, we isolate structural mechanics from textural complexity inherent in natural imagery and introduce a rigorous color-aware layout metric to quantify spatial fidelity. We show that training on a centered SNR distribution results in poor layout adherence (25.9%). Instead, we identify high-noise regimes as a "critical learning phase" for spatial grounding. Shifting the training focus toward these stages increases layout adherence to 80.8%, effectively reaching the 83.6% reconstruction ceiling of the underlying variational autoencoder. We find that the necessity for this shift scales with resolution and aspect ratio variance, and that the conservative noise schedules employed by models like FLUX.1 are insufficient for precise layout adherence. Finally, we show that these findings translate to real-world imagery via the COCO dataset (1.0 vs. 57.3 Average Precision), where state-of-the-art layout adherence is unlocked through distribution tuning alone, without architectural modifications.

papers.title_en: Efficient Generative Image Compression with Quantized Latents Refinement
papers.authors: Hao Cao, Yinhuan Huang, Wenqi Guo, Zhijin Qin, Jungong Han
papers.evidence: 基于扩散潜变量精炼的生成式图像压缩
papers.tldr: 生成式图像压缩在低码率下感知质量突出，但强感知方法依赖扩散模型而延迟高，轻量方法虽快却因粗量化导致细节潜变量坍缩、质量下降。为此提出GR-GIC：以熵上下文引导的潜变量细化并结合自适应扰动正则化，同时将投影残差向量量化重组为低维查表以提升并行度。在Kodak上相比OneDC，LPIPS、DISTS、PSNR、FID的BD-rate分别节省23.19%、37.71%、22.30%、22.14%；A100编解码仅4.60/5.98 ms，P-RVQ平均加速3.14倍。该工作兼顾感知质量与快速推理，并可在边缘设备达到轻量GIC级延迟。
papers.abstract_en: Generative image compression (GIC) delivers strong perceptual quality at low bitrates. However, GIC methods with strong perceptual quality often rely on pretrained diffusion models with high latency, while recent lightweight GIC methods reduce latency but deliver lower perceptual quality. We observe that, for lightweight GIC methods at low bitrates, coarse deterministic quantization can collapse nearby encoder latents corresponding to different fine details to the same point, making these details difficult to recover. Motivated by this, we propose GR-GIC, an efficient GIC that delivers competitive reconstruction performance with fast inference. For better performance, we introduce Guided Refinement (GR), which combines latent refinement guided by entropy context with adaptive perturbations for training regularization, jointly improving reconstruction at low bitrates. For fast inference, we introduce reorganized projected residual vector quantization (P-RVQ), which equivalently reorganizes residual updates into low-dimensional lookups to expose greater parallelism and reduce sequential computation. Experiments on Kodak show that for performance, compared with OneDC, GR-GIC achieves BD-rate savings of 23.19%, 37.71%, 22.30%, and 22.14% for LPIPS, DISTS, PSNR, and FID, respectively. For fast inference, the highly optimized implementation of GR-GIC encodes and decodes in 4.60 and 5.98 ms on an NVIDIA A100. Specifically, the reorganized P-RVQ implementation achieves a $3.14\times$ average speedup over the original implementation under the same FP32 setting. On an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX, GR-GIC achieves latency comparable to lightweight GIC methods.
